entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. Now, so I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand Pulse? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
I just don't like it. It's not what I expected.
Okay, so it's not malfunctioning, it just wasn't the right fit for you. I understand. Let me review the timeline here... I see the device was delivered to you 25 days ago.
Well, I've reviewed your request against our returns framework, and I'm afraid it is now too late to process a return for this item.
What do you mean 'too late'? I haven't even used it that much.

I understand, but our return policy for wearable electronics is very strict for health and safety reasons. We cannot accept returns on these devices after 20 days. This is a firm company policy for hygiene and sanitation purposes.
So you're saying because I waited a few weeks, I'm just stuck with a product I don't want. That's some policy.

I recognize this is frustrating to hear, but yes. Due to the nature of the device being worn on the skin, the policy is in place to prevent any bio-contaminant risks, and I don't have the ability to make an exception. The window for a return has passed.
Fine. Whatever. Guess I know not to shop here again.
I am sorry we couldn't reach a different outcome today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No. You've been a huge help.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
